list.title: Waibu#_handleFavicon
list.description:
Create route for '/favicon.:ext'

Location of favicon file can be found in:

  1. main plugin's file; if not found, then
  2. site attachment; if not found, then
  3. static dir of theme; if not found, then
  4. default plugin's file

list.title: factory
list.description:
Plugin factory.

Never call this function directly!!! It's only-meant to be called by the {@link https://ardhi.github.io/bajo|Bajo framework} during plugin initialization.

list.title: module:Helper.buildLocals
list.description: Build the locals object for the template rendering.

list.title: module:Helper.collectWebApps
list.description: Collect web apps by scanning for files that match the specified glob pattern. It will import the modules and gather their metadata.

list.title: module:Helper.decorate
list.description: Decorate the request object with additional properties and methods for handling language, translation, formatting, and settings retrieval.

list.title: module:Helper.download
list.description: Helper to handle file download. It will set proper content-type based on file extension.

list.title: module:Helper.interceptor
list.description: Interceptor for handling errors and delegating to specific web app handlers if available.

list.title: module:Helper.notFound
list.description: Handle 404 Not Found errors. It will check for a redirect route, and if found, redirect the user. If no redirect route is found, it will render a 404 error page using the specified template.

list.title: module:Helper.redirect
list.description: Handle redirection based on the error object. It will redirect to the specified path or URL.

list.title: module:Helper.writeHtml
list.description: Write HTML content to the reply object. It will read the template file, compile it with the provided payload, and send the resulting HTML as the response.

list.title: module:Hook
list.description:
Register the following hooks to the application:

  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:onClose}
  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:onReady}
  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:onRequest}
  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:onResponse}
  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:preParsing}
  • {@link module:Hook.waibu:onRoute}

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:onClose
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:onClose' event. The handler is invoked when the server is closed and logs a message indicating that the server has been closed.

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:onReady
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:onReady' event. The handler is invoked when the server is ready and logs a message indicating that the server is ready.

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:onRequest
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:onRequest' event. The handler is invoked when a request is received and logs the request details, including the method, URL, and IP address.

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:onResponse
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:onResponse' event. The handler is invoked when a response is sent and logs the response details, including the method, URL, status code, and elapsed time.

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:onRoute
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:onRoute' event. The handler is invoked when a new route is registered and adds the route options to the list of routes.

list.title: module:Hook.waibu:preParsing
list.description: Hook object for the 'waibu:preParsing' event. The handler is invoked before parsing the request and attaches internationalization (i18n) support to the request and reply objects.

list.title: module:WebApp.attachIntl
list.description: Attach internationalization (i18n) methods to the request object as defined by decorator during plugin startup. It will set the language, translation, and formatting functions.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleCompress
list.description: Handle compression middleware. It will register the compression middleware with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleCors
list.description: Handle CORS middleware. It will register the CORS middleware with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleHelmet
list.description: Handle Helmet middleware. It will register the Helmet middleware with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleMultipartBody
list.description: Handle multipart body middleware. It will register the multipart middleware with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleRateLimit
list.description: Handle rate limit middleware. It will register the rate limit middleware with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.handleXmlBody
list.description:
Handle XML body middleware. It will register the XML body parser middleware with the specified options.

Requires the {@link https://github.com/ardhi/bajo-extra} plugin to be installed.

list.title: module:WebApp.mergeRouteHooks
list.description: Merge route hooks. It will merge the route hooks with the specified options.

list.title: module:WebApp.reroutedPath
list.description: Reroute the given path based on the provided mapper.

list.title: module:WebApp.routeHook
list.description: Register route hooks for the specified namespace.

list.title: module:WebApp~detect
list.description: Detect the language based on the specified detectors (path, query string, header) and set it on the request object.
